text: I’m putting the warning before anything good I say about psychedelics for relationships, because people need to hear it before they take anything. I don’t think sexual consent should be negotiated for the first time while high, when the drug is changing how safe, loving, open, and connected everything feels. And even if the two of you plan it all in advance, getting high and starting a relationship is still a risk.
reader: someone reading an essay on romance for advice they can use in their own dating and relationships

question_text.Q1: Why am I reading this sentence, and do I know it before I have to work through it? (the point first, in each sentence and each paragraph; a study after the question it answers; a term explained where it is first used, never in a sentence after it)

question_text.Q4: What does each word act on, or mean here?
